input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 applies New York law and Section 28.2 confers exclusive jurisdiction on the state and federal courts in New York County, which is exactly our preferred position. There is no arbitration provision anywhere in the agreement (search for "arbitration" returns nothing), so no foreign seat concern. The mutual pre-filing executive escalation in 28.3 (fifteen business days, with carve-outs for urgent relief and limitations periods) and the mutual injunctive-relief carve-out in 28.2 are balanced, apply to both parties, and do not displace the accepted forum; noted only, not a deviation.
